name: adopt-freed-time-agreement
description: Prepares a team conversation guide and a one-page record of which tasks now take less effort, what the team stops doing, where freed time goes, what does not expand and a workload check date. Use for "run adopt-freed-time-agreement", "freed time agreement", "what happens to the time AI saves", "AI just means more work", "time saved turns into more tasks", "where does saved time go", "team conversation about workload and AI", "agree what we stop doing", part of the Claude Guide for AI Adoption Pack by 90n.
